rules.title: Jersey City Code § 218-12 - Algorithmic Rent Coordination Ban
rules.requirement: Landlords in Jersey City cannot use algorithmic software or services that coordinate rents with other landlords to set rental prices.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to landlords using algorithmic rent coordination services; no unit-count threshold stated.
rules.penalty: Fines up to $2,000 per day; public and private enforcement
rules.quoted_span:
Jersey City Code § 218-12 (effective June 2025)
Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day.
